text: CEVA Logistics is a subsidiary of the CMA CGM Group. CMA CGM made a public tender offer for all publicly held CEVA shares; the shares still held by the public were cancelled by a Swiss court decision in September 2019, and CEVA was delisted from the SIX Swiss Exchange as of 10 October 2019.
short: CEVA Logistics is a CMA CGM subsidiary; its last public shares were cancelled in 2019.

source.name: CMA CGM Group – CMA CGM reports strong annual financial results for 2024
source.quote: the CMA CGM Group, via its CEVA Logistics subsidiary, played a crucial role in the reception, storage, preparation and customs clearance of goods and equipment

additionalSources.name: CEVA Logistics – Cancellation of publicly held CEVA shares and delisting from SIX Swiss Exchange as of 10 October 2019 (press release)
additionalSources.quote: corresponding to the offer price paid by CMA CGM S.A. in its public tender offer for all publicly held shares of CEVA
